With experience in integrating cloud-base tools with micro-motors in cell culture, she actively contributes to enhancing research experience accessibility to undergraduate students . Her educational background includes a B.S. in Medical Technology, a Master's degree in Chemical and Biological Engineering from KAUST, and a Ph.D. in Bioengineering from the University of California, Los Angeles. Dr. Khojah has also worked as a post-doctoral researcher at the University of California, Santa Cruz, and the University of California, Irvine. Recent Publications and Awards Contact Me Get in Touch!
